title: quickemu catalog entry
description: Shape of one entry inside catalog/data/catalog.json — mirrors the Entry struct in tools/quickget-catalog and the items schema in schemas/v1/catalog.schema.json. If the catalog is ever split into one file per OS (progressive refactor), each file validates against this.

os.description: Family key — the slug quickget accepts.

releases.description: Release names/versions; empty when 'scrape' resolves them live.

arch.description: Guest architectures offered; absent means amd64.

url.description: Download URL template; %s placeholders interpolate release/edition.

iso.description: Explicit ISO filename template when it cannot be derived from url.

hash_re.description: Regex selecting the checksum line inside hash_url content.

scrape.description: Resolve releases/URL live via the family's scrape case instead of static fields.

qarch.description: URL template uses QEMU arch names (x86_64/aarch64) rather than amd64/arm64.
